For a 2-bedroom apartment in Hyderabad, I’d budget roughly ₹3,500–₹5,500 for a proper move-in deep clean. If the flat is empty, you can usually get it done cheaper than a furnished apartment. Current Hyderabad listings show this range pretty consistently.

NoBroker currently lists furnished-apartment packages around ₹4,209–₹5,579 and unfurnished packages around ₹3,539–₹4,109 in Hyderabad.

 HomeTriangle lists full-home furnished cleaning from ₹3,749 and a new-apartment cleaning package from ₹3,899, specifically aimed at removing construction dust/residue. 
HomeTriangle

What I'd book for a move-in

If your apartment is empty, I'd choose something around ₹3,800–₹4,500 that explicitly includes:

Bathroom deep cleaning + tile/grout scrubbing

Kitchen degreasing, sink, countertop and tiles

Machine scrubbing of floors

Windows + window tracks

Doors and frames

Fans and ceiling dusting

Switchboards/sockets

Balcony

Cobweb removal

Inside empty cupboards/wardrobes

Removal of construction dust if it's a new/just-renovated flat

For a genuinely new apartment, HomeTriangle's package explicitly covers cement dust, machine floor scrubbing, cabinets/shelves, switches, kitchen surfaces, tile/grout scrubbing and tap descaling. 
HomeTriangle

Local Hyderabad alternatives

If you want to negotiate directly rather than use an aggregator, these have strong current ratings/review counts:

SS - Home Deep Cleaning & Pest Control Services Hyderabad — 4.8, 855 reviews

Happi Home Deep cleaning services — 4.8, 378 reviews

ICON HOME CLEANING SERVICES — 4.8, 542 reviews

Homeclean Expert Services — 4.7, 380 reviews

TechSquadTeam — 4.5, 976 reviews

My pick: For a pre-move-in clean, I'd first check HomeTriangle vs NoBroker. If you want the lowest price, get one quote from a well-reviewed local provider and ask them to match a ₹3,500–₹4,000 all-inclusive package.

One important point: don't compare only the headline price. Ask whether cupboard interiors, window tracks, balcony, grout, exhaust fans and heavy dust are included. Those are common places where a ₹2,500 quote turns into ₹4,000+.

If you tell me the Hyderabad area/locality (e.g. Gachibowli, Kondapur, Hitech City, Madhapur, Kukatpally), I can narrow this to 3–5 providers that serve your area and compare their current reviews and pricing.
